level_1.title: Level 1: Outpost Sector
level_1.description: A compact 3-qubit Clifford payload. Compare the no-check baseline with single-check and two-check strategies; checks have no score penalty in this onboarding mission.

level_2.title: Level 2: Hazardous Corridor
level_2.description: A deeper 4-qubit Clifford payload. Check overhead is about 4.5 score points per check, so only stronger single-target strategies should beat the baseline.

level_3.title: Level 3: Deep Lattice Storm
level_3.description: A 5-qubit Clifford payload. Check overhead is 9.6 score points per check, narrowing the strategies that can beat no-check.

level_4.title: Level 4: Thermal Decay Nexus
level_4.description: A 6-qubit, deeper Clifford payload with a 10-point score penalty per check. Validate the remaining viable strategies against the no-check baseline.

level_5.title: Level 5: Clifford Core Meltdown
level_5.description: The largest 7-qubit Clifford payload with an 11-point score penalty per check, designed so the no-check baseline is difficult to beat.
